purpose.zh: 拉伸大腿内侧，改善髋部活动度
purpose.en: Stretch the inner thigh and improve hip mobility.

text.zh: 背部保持平直，臀部向后坐向脚跟
text.en: Keep your back long and rock your hips back toward your heel

text.zh: 一条腿向侧伸直，整只脚踩地，脚尖朝前
text.en: Reach one leg straight out to the side, foot flat and toes forward.

text.zh: 大腿内侧有拉伸感时停一下，再向前回
text.en: Pause when you feel the inner thigh stretch, then rock forward.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back as you rock back.

commonErrors.zh: 伸直腿的脚离地或膝盖弯曲
commonErrors.en: Lifting the straight-leg foot or bending that knee.

cautions.zh: 只到舒适的拉伸感，腹股沟刺痛就停止
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and stop if your groin feels sharp pain.
